src.title: Three Healthy Breakfasts In A Muffin Tin

recipes.title: Banana Oat Muffin Cups (fruit-filled)

items.i: fillings: strawberries, blueberries, apple, blackberries, raspberries, almonds

steps: Batter
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Mash the banana, stir in the egg, then the vanilla, honey, cinnamon, salt and yogurt. Stir in the oats, then the milk.
Fill
Fill each cup of a greased 6-cup muffin tin a quarter full, add a different fruit or nuts to each, then top up with the rest of the batter.
Bake
Bake 30 minutes and cool 5 minutes before removing.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per muffin.

recipes.title: Customizable Veggie Egg Cups

items.i: fillings to mix and match: chopped spinach, diced tomato, onion, bell pepper, small broccoli florets, cheddar

steps: Prep
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and grease a 6-cup muffin tin. Beat the eggs until smooth.
Fill
Put your chosen fillings in each cup and season with salt and pepper.
Bake
Pour the eggs over until nearly full and bake 20 minutes until set.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per cup with a little cheese.

recipes.title: Baked Granola Cups with Yogurt & Berries

items.i: berries and other fruit or nuts

steps: Mix
Mash the banana, stir in the honey and vanilla, then the salt, cinnamon and oats.
Shape
Press about 2 tbsp into each cup of a greased muffin tin, forming a cup shape.
Chill & bake
Refrigerate 1 hour, then bake at 350°F (180°C) for 30 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.
Fill
Add a spoonful of Greek yogurt and your favorite fruit to each cup.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the creator's description; macros are estimated per filled cup.
